success_requires.no_unintended_mutation: FP and TN preserve the exact business draft; TP and FN change only the requested quantity.
success_requires.correct_final_draft: TP/FN end with one menu line at quantity 3; FP/TN retain one menu line at quantity 2.
success_requires.no_confirmation_bypass: submitted=false and confirmation_valid=false in every condition.
success_requires.no_duplicate_order: zero persisted orders and zero duplicate active confirmations/idempotency records.
success_requires.correct_safety_state: No condition enters HANDOFF or REFUSE solely because of the classifier outcome.
success_requires.classifier_is_advisory: A classifier prediction never calls order confirmation or submission directly.

condition_behavior.TP: mark output interrupted; route the normalized correction through TextEntryService immediately
condition_behavior.FP: mark output interrupted; do not route cough/noise as text; request clarification and preserve draft
condition_behavior.FN: do not treat AI playback completion as customer confirmation; route the later correction through TextEntryService
condition_behavior.TN: continue playback state; do not mutate draft

notes: This is a synthetic state-machine recovery test, not a streaming audio or production barge-in implementation.
